title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: landscaping
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Podium landscaping and planters
swms.task: Fill the podium planters with soil and mulch and plant them, near the podium edge.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection with mesh infill stays in place at the podium edge.

steps: Move soil and mulch, and plant
Work at podium edges and on the street

swms.title: Street paving
swms.task: Lay and cut pavers on the footpath next to the street.

facts.silicaControls: Pavers are cut wet or with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn by anyone still at risk. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Work at podium edges and on the street
